verification.hypothesis_property: all permutations of the seven event times accepted only in strict chronological order

limitations: The fixture uses synthetic roots and does not establish an OS snapshot identity or held APFS descriptor.
The root locator digest and closure rows remain synthetic fixture inputs; this verifier does not prove a real source path is inside a mounted snapshot.
Tree page references and SQLite backup hashes are bound to the proof, but xattrs, ACLs, flags, uid/gid parity, and application semantics are not qualified.
No K journal prefix, clean-host restore, complete owner/protected custody, or erase readiness is established.
